title: A/R Detail: the PDF and CSV name each credit as the screen does
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a customer with an open invoice A, an unused credit memo A and an unused deposit A.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only that customer ticked in the Customer filter.
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the PDF and read the Transaction Type of each row.
  3. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Open the CSV and read its "Transaction Type" column.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 2:

  • Invoice A reads "Invoice", credit memo A "Credit Memo" and deposit A "Deposit".
  • No row reads "Credit".

Step 3:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 4:

  • Invoice A reads "Invoice", credit memo A "Credit Memo" and deposit A "Deposit", the same as the PDF.
  • No row reads "Credit".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S2-R1b: “Transaction Type reads "Invoice" for invoices and bills, as today, and names each kind of credit: "Credit Memo" and "Deposit" on A/R, "Vendor Credit" on A/P. The same names appear in the PDF and the CSV, and Transaction Type sorts A to Z by these names (S2-R2).”
  • S3-R3: “The PDF and the CSV contain exactly the rows on screen for the chosen as-of date, customer or vendor and locations, in the on-screen sort, including a sort changed after an earlier export, without refreshing the page.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html). The design's pictures were taken before this rule: they show Transaction Type "Credit" for every credit (DD-07 below); the case follows the PRD.

Difference from the PRD (DD-07), closed: PRD version 10 (4 Nov 2026) says Transaction Type "names each kind of credit: "Credit Memo" and "Deposit" on A/R, "Vendor Credit" on A/P" (S2-R1b); the design shows Transaction Type "Credit" on every credit memo, deposit and vendor credit row (for example in "Expand all from the header", "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices", "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible", "Cancel stays on the report" and "Vendor credits link"). Closed by the later PRD ruling: PRD version 10 (4 Nov 2026, Chris Ward, the design authority) added S2-R1b after these pictures were taken and lists it under What changes for existing users ("today all three read "Credit""); version 11 keeps it. Compare the layout with the pictures; the Transaction Type words come from the PRD.
